fullPassage: In the natural world, if an animal consumes a plant with enough antinutrients to make it feel unwell, it won't eat that plant again. Intuitively, animals also know to stay away from these plants. Years of evolution and information being passed down created this innate intelligence. This "intuition," though, is not just seen in animals. Have you ever wondered why most children hate vegetables? Dr. Steven Gundry justifies this as part of our genetic programming, our inner intelligence. Since many vegetables are full of antinutrients, your body tries to keep you away from them while you are still fragile and in development. It does this by making your taste buds perceive these flavors as bad and even disgusting. As you grow and your body becomes stronger enough to tolerate these antinutrients, suddenly they no longer taste as bad as before.

det.analysis:
❌ ① 채소의 영양학적 가치는 글의 주제 아님
❌ ② 동물의 식습관 변화는 일부 내용일 뿐
❌ ③ 어린이 편식 교정법은 언급 없음
✅ ④ 항영양소에 대한 본능적/유전적 방어 메커니즘 ← 정답
det.tip: innate intelligence + genetic programming = 타고난 방어

questions.passage: In the natural world, if an animal consumes a plant with enough antinutrients to make it feel unwell, it won't eat that plant again. Intuitively, animals also know to stay away from these plants. Years of evolution and information being passed down created this innate intelligence. This "intuition," though, is not just seen in animals. Have you ever wondered why most children hate vegetables? Dr. Steven Gundry justifies this as part of our genetic programming, our inner intelligence. Since many vegetables are full of antinutrients, your body tries to keep you away from them while you are still fragile and in development. It does this by making your taste buds perceive these flavors as bad and even disgusting. As you grow and your body becomes stronger enough to tolerate these antinutrients, suddenly they no longer taste as bad as before.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ 아이들이 채소를 싫어하는 것은 유전적 프로그래밍에 의한 자연스러운 보호 반응이다
det.analysis:
❌ ① 모든 채소가 해롭다는 주장(×, 성장 후 tolerate)
❌ ② 동물만 항영양소를 감지(×, not just seen in animals)
✅ ③ 유전적 프로그래밍 + 성장 시 변화 ← 정답
❌ ④ 항영양소는 성인에게도 위험(×, stronger enough to tolerate)

ch: 채소에 포함된 항영양소는 모든 연령대에게 해롭다.
아이들의 채소 기피는 유전적 프로그래밍에 의한 보호 반응이다.
성장 후에도 항영양소에 대한 거부감은 사라지지 않는다.
